_doc: Maps alternate/historical bank slugs to canonical. Consumed by lib/slug-aliases.js#aliasToCanonical, applied in pack/build-pack.js at file-read time and scripts/quality-gate.js at compare time so that runs and baselines using either spelling resolve to the same identity. Add a new entry when two slugs refer to the same RBI-listed bank; leave the alternate entry out of data/bank-domains.json so the registry stays single-source.
_authored: 2026-05-23 (Fix #9) — addresses cohort #1→#2 'bank dropped from pack' anomalies where the new run and the baseline used different slug spellings for the same bank.
